_comment: Hardware variants. Same board (YD_F102_MIPI_V3.0), different LCD panels. Variant A runs the seller's kernel unchanged; variant B needs the panel-init patch below. Never flash one variant's image on the other.

a.title: Variant A: panel K101-IM2CYL02-L
a.panel_id: not captured yet (UART boot log line 'mipi id read ok' of a variant-A frame is needed)
a.kernel: stock 16.10, no kernel patch, config untouched

b.title: Variant B: panel HT101D08S / JDH328DK0
b.kernel: stock 16.10 + replaced ILI9881 init routine (table linux_k101_im2byl02_init) + stock auto_mipi timing
